asset.name: Box
asset.description: The token-aware polymorphic layout primitive for the narrow set of cases where no semantic higher-level primitive fits, deliberately unopinionated about everything except which values are legal.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.

rationale: Included reluctantly. A Box is an escape hatch, and its presence should stay rare enough that its usage count is a meaningful signal about missing primitives.
